name: Process Step Condition
description: One clause of a step's visibility rule, evaluated against an earlier step's answer. Deliberately structured rows rather than a formula language: no eval(), and still editable by a non-programmer. Clauses combine left-to-right using each row's `join`. Held flat on the Process Definition and matched to its step by `step_code`.

fields.label: When Step
fields.description: The step_code of an earlier step in the same process.

fields.label: Operator
fields.options:
Equals
Not Equals
Greater Than
Less Than
Is Answered
Is Not Answered
Is Pass
Is Failed
Is Out Of Range
Is Skipped

fields.label: Value
fields.description: Compared against the earlier step's answer. Ignored by the Is/Has operators.

fields.label: Join
fields.description: How this clause combines with the one before it.
